home.hero_subtitle: Report, analyze, and visualize safety concerns in your workplace, school, or community. Private. Anonymous. AI-powered.
home.feature_1_desc: Your reports are protected. Submit anonymously or with a verified account.
home.feature_2_desc: Automatic keyword extraction, risk tagging, and severity classification.
home.feature_3_desc: Visualize trends and identify patterns before harm escalates.

report.title: Report an Incident
report.description_hint: Describe what happened. Be as detailed as you feel safe sharing.
report.location_hint: e.g. Downtown area, 3rd floor office, school gym...
report.ai_delay_hint: AI summary may take up to 25 seconds on first submission.
report.photo_hint: JPEG, PNG, GIF or WebP — max 5MB. No metadata is stored.

library.title: Incident Library
library.no_incidents: No incidents found. Be the first to report.

guidance.title: Safety Guidance
guidance.subtitle: Practical guidance for staying safe, documenting incidents, and knowing your rights.
guidance.privacy_body: VigilSafe does not sell, share, or disclose your personal data to third parties. Anonymous reports contain no identifying information. Logged-in reports are visible only to you and administrators of your organization.
guidance.terms_body: By using VigilSafe, you agree to use this platform solely for documenting legitimate safety concerns. Misuse, including false reports, may result in account termination. VigilSafe is a documentation tool — for emergencies, always contact local emergency services first.
